The goal is simple.  

Beat your prior best in everything you do.  

In business 
In health 
In parenting 
In marriage 
In decision making 
In your spiritual walk

As long as you continue to improve daily, eventually the efforts will compound.
Capitalism works so well that even its socialist like @BernieSanders became a millionaire.

Mark my word!

2028 presidential race will break every rule in politics.

An open battlefield w/out Trump in it.

Strange people will be running.

Hollywood stars
Influencers
Podcasters
Former athletes
Pastors

I have a list of 22 outsiders that could be running.

It’ll be nasty!

Death penalty is not enough.  

Mutilation?
Castration?
Then public execution.  

You have to make a public example of this evil behavior or else it’ll continue.


Breanna Morello (@BreannaMorello)

🚨HORRIFYING🚨

Jurors will listen to the audio of 7-year-old Athena Strand being strangled to death by FedEx driver Tanner Horner.

Horner pleaded guilty to capital murder, but a juror will decide if he should be sentenced to death. 

Strand told the child, “Don't scream or I'll hurt you,” as he picke

At least it’s better than what America got trading Brittney Griner for Viktor Bout.


ESPN (@espn)

Breaking: Angel Reese is being traded to the Atlanta Dream. The Dream are trading a 2027 first-round pick and 2028 first-round pick to the Chicago Sky for the two-time All-Star and 2028 second-round swap rights, sources tell @kendra__andrews.

Prime Video first reported that the teams agreed to a trade involving Reese.





— https://nitter.net/espn/status/2041179324078809250#m

This is embarrassing, however… 

NASA’s Artemis launch: $4B
California bullet train: $126B

Meanwhile, Musk launches SpaceX rockets for roughly $70M.

Government builds cost billions.
Entrepreneurs figure out how to do it for millions.

Your kids need you.
Your wife needs you.
Your business needs you.

And somehow you still show up.

No excuses. No spotlight. No complaints.

Respect to the men who are grateful & carry the load without complaining.

🫡

The more she speaks, the more it hurts Newsome’s chances in 2028.

Republicans should want her speaking everyday.

Video

Ceasefires succeed when they’re part of a structured path to peace, not just a timeout.

Who’s convinced anyone will commit to a cease fire? 

There’s zero trust by either party.

Not sure how long this’ll last even though markets are reacting positively after hours.

Grateful for faith, family, and the reminder that new life is always possible.

He is risen. Happy Easter.🐣✝️

Canada politicians have lost their minds.  

A new bill if passed considers parts of the Bible hate speech.  

The bill may remove or weaken a religious exemption. 

I hope Canadians conservatives are making noise about Bill C-9.

Video

One election away from her being your “First Lady”.  

Gavin Newsome wife’s philosophy on parenting. 👇🏽
